name: performance
description: Measure mountOS performance against a baseline on a mounted volume: a concurrent mixed workload with latency percentiles and correctness counters, metadata rates with mdtest, and small-file workload timing. Also diagnoses low throughput from a client far from the region: round-trip time, block storage host network tuning, and client buffer limits on Linux and macOS.

compatibility.note: Loads current documentation from https://mountos.io on every use.
